title: jmap-server: conditional dispatcher evaluator, decision-2 check, atomic mapping
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C3. Crates: jmap-server (conditional.rs, lib.rs, one visibility line in helpers.rs). Size: L.

Implement docs/design/conditional.md §5.2 and §5.3 (conditional-02 §2.1, §3, §3.1 rules 1-5, §3.2, §3.3, §4.1-4.3, §9.1, §9.2). In Dispatcher for every method ending in /set: step 1 (decision 2, docs/design/DECISIONS.md): URI absent from using and atomic not in {absent,null,false} or ifUnchangedBy not in {absent,null,{}} -> invalidArguments, handler not called, on every deployment; default values stripped. Steps 2-11: take_args validation; no SetSupport -> invalidArguments; begin_set (Atomic/Isolated) with CannotApplyAtomically mapping; run under SET_SCOPE; set_guard for "<type>/get" -> forbidden; resolve #creation keys via created_ids; call the registered Foo/get with properties = pointer top-level names + id; ifInState vs /get state; unknown name -> invalidArguments, unreadable/hidden_properties -> forbidden before values; RFC 6901 pointer walk (make helpers::decode_pointer_token pub(crate)); stateMismatch with failed only when all failing keys resolved; call inner handler with cx.atomic; non-atomic commit; atomic: Err -> rollback; non-empty notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed/notRestored -> rollback + atomicFailure (notRestored via with_not_restored, decision 6(b)), extra_invocations dropped; commit Rejected -> atomicFailure mapping Create(id) to creation id and Restore(id) to notRestored. Add conditional_gaps() and conditional_ready() (decision 1: at least one SetSupport and no gaps). Acceptance: every jmap-server dispatcher test listed in §10 (probe Probe/get + Probe/set backend), including the decision-2 and decision-1 cases and a dispatcher with no SetSupport; hand-written spec JSON oracles; snapshot additions only.
